text.description_html:
Acorn AZC-202-3.5, Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel 3.5 Cabinet Pull

The 3-1/2 Inch Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull is a modern pull that will add contemporary flair to any kitchen cabinet. It is 5 inches in length with a 3-1/2 inch center to center. Made out of stainless steel, the Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel 3.5 Cabinet Pull is available in polished and brushed finishes.

Also Available: 3 Inch Center to Center Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull and 4 Inch Center to Center Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull

Specifications for the Absolute Zero Collection Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull Acorn AZC-202-3.5:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length (c.c hole spacing): 3.5"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
